map.根据机场海拔、气温与跑道坡度对基准起飞长度进行修正，计算实际所需跑道长度，用于飞: Correct the baseline takeoff length for airport altitude, temperature and runway slope to compute the actual runway length required, for flight performance assessment.
map.ISA 温度 = 15 − 0.0065 × 海拔(m)；修正长 = 基准长 ×: ISA temperature = 15 − 0.0065 × altitude (m); corrected length = base length × weight factor × (1 + altitude/300 × 0.07) × (1 + max(0, ΔT) × 0.01) × (1 + slope × 0.10) × (1 − headwind/5 × 0.07); recommended length = corrected length × 1.15
map.海拔每高 300m 需加长 7%、高于 ISA 每 1℃ 加长 1%、上坡每 1: For every 300 m of altitude add 7%, for every 1°C above ISA add 1%, for every 1% of uphill gradient add 10%, and for every 5 m/s of headwind subtract 7% (up to 30%); then add a 15% safety margin on top.
map.按机型基准跑道长度，叠加海拔、温度、坡度、顶风等修正，得实际所需长度。: Start from the baseline runway length of the aircraft type and layer in the altitude, temperature, slope and headwind corrections to get the actual length required.
map.高原/高温机场评估起飞重量限制（跑道不够则减载）。: Assess takeoff weight limits at high-altitude or high-temperature airports (reduce payload when the runway is too short).
map.对比湿跑道（摩擦降低）的额外长度需求。: The extra length needed for a wet runway (lower friction).
map.高原高温跑道修正示意: Runway correction example at high altitude and temperature
map.：某机型基准跑道 2500 m（海平面 ISA）。机场海拔 1500 m 密度高: Example: the baseline runway of an aircraft type is 2500 m (sea level, ISA). An airport altitude of 1500 m adds about +12% for density altitude, a temperature 10°C above standard adds +6%, and a 1% slope adds +3%, so 2500×1.21 ≈ 3025 m is needed. In practice follow the correction tables in the aircraft performance manual.
map.为什么顶风可以缩短跑道？: Why can a headwind shorten the runway?
map.顶风提高地速达到离地空速的滑跑效率，等效缩短所需地面滑跑距离；顺风反之。性能计算: A headwind raises the ground speed reached for the same lift-off airspeed, which improves the ground run efficiency and effectively shortens the required ground roll; a tailwind does the opposite. Performance calculations include the headwind component as a negative correction.
map.湿跑道为什么要求更长？: Why does a wet runway require more length?
map.湿滑道面刹车与加速性能下降、中断起飞距离增大，需更长跑道或更严的重量限制。规章对: A wet or contaminated runway reduces braking and acceleration performance and increases the takeoff distance, so a longer runway or stricter weight limits are needed. The regulations include specific performance penalties for wet or contaminated runways.
